one_liner: Marketing automation, email marketing, and CRM platform for customer experience orchestration.

auth.auth_notes: All requests to the API are authenticated by providing your API key. The API key should be provided as an HTTP header named `Api-Token`.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: ActiveCampaign's remote MCP server uses OAuth authentication. No API key handling is required. All credentials are managed through the OAuth flow with ActiveCampaign.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Copy your unique Remote MCP URL from Settings -> Developer. Available for all plan tiers. No coding required to connect.

buildability_signal.notes: Official remote MCP server with broad coverage. OAuth-based auth for MCP is separate from API key auth. Strong integration potential.

evidence.quote: All requests to the API are authenticated by providing your API key. The API key should be provided as an HTTP header named `Api-Token`.
ActiveCampaign's remote MCP server makes it easy for AI agents to understand, store, and use customer context across tools, channels, and workflows.
Authentication happens via OAuth from the client (Claude Desktop, the Claude web app, or ChatGPT with Developer Mode), so there is no API key handling, npm install, or self-hosting required.
ActiveCampaign authenticates every API surface with one flat, unscoped API key sent in an Api-Token header. There is no OAuth, no OIDC, no scopes, no token expiry and no refresh.

research_notes: Official remote MCP server available. REST API uses API key only. MCP server uses OAuth. Community MCP servers also exist with more comprehensive tool coverage (~325 tools vs curated subset).

one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for email campaigns, SMS, WhatsApp, CRM, and transactional messaging.

auth.auth_notes: Use API key authentication for direct API access. Include your API key in the `api-key` header for each request. Use OAuth 2.0 when your application needs to act on behalf of a Brevo user.

access.access_notes: Log in to your Brevo account and open the SMTP & API settings page. Under the API keys tab, click Generate a new API key.

api_surface.breadth_notes: Covers contacts, lists, campaigns, transactional emails, SMS, WhatsApp, CRM deals/companies/tasks, webhooks, ecommerce, account management, and more.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: The MCP server uses Bearer token authentication. All endpoints use the base URL https://mcp.brevo.com.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Connect to the main server for access to all features, or to individual servers for specific needs. MCP server available at https://mcp.brevo.com/v1/brevo/mcp.

buildability_signal.notes: Official MCP server with 27 modules. Both API key and OAuth 2.0 supported for REST API. Strong integration potential.

evidence.quote: API keys authenticate your requests to the Brevo API. Generate an API key from your account settings and include it in the `api-key` header for all API requests.
Brevo OAuth 2.0 lets your application request access to a user's Brevo account with their consent.
The Brevo MCP Server lets you use AI assistants to interact with your Brevo account using natural language.
Authorization: Bearer paste-your-mcp-token-here

research_notes: Official MCP server with comprehensive module coverage. OAuth 2.0 is private only (within organization). Public OAuth support planned for future release.

one_liner: Email marketing and creator commerce platform for newsletters, sequences, and subscriber management.

auth.auth_notes: We support two authentication mechanisms in the V4 API: OAuth 2.0 for apps available for all creators in the Kit App Store, and API keys for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account.

access.access_notes: To use API Key authentication, you must first create a V4 API Key. To do this, visit the 'Developer' tab in your account settings.

api_surface.breadth_notes: Covers subscribers, tags, custom fields, sequences, broadcasts, forms, purchases, segments, webhooks, accounts, and email templates. V4 API with comprehensive coverage.

mcp_auth.mcp_auth_notes: The Kit MCP uses OAuth authentication. When you connect Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or any MCP-compatible AI tool to Kit, you set your own permissions and can revoke access anytime.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: Copy Kit's MCP server URL (https://app.kit.com/mcp) and paste it into your AI tool's connector settings. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and more.

buildability_signal.notes: Official MCP server with 65+ tools. Both API key and OAuth 2.0 supported. API keys have lower rate limits (120/min vs 600/min for OAuth). Some endpoints require OAuth.
buildability_signal.mcp_notes: MCP requires OAuth authentication. API keys cannot be used with MCP.

evidence.claim: V4 API supports both API key and OAuth
evidence.quote: We support two authentication mechanisms in the V4 API: OAuth 2.0 for apps available for all creators in the Kit App Store, and API keys for automating simple tools and integrations for your own account.
Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and more directly to Kit so every AI analysis and action is personal to your business, your audience, and your list.
Your AI tool opens a Kit sign-in page in your browser. Review the requested permissions and click Allow.
oauth: required_for: Any app published to the Kit App Store, all bulk endpoints, purchase creation, and the Kit MCP

research_notes: Official MCP server with broad tool coverage. OAuth required for MCP and bulk endpoints. API keys limited to personal automation. Rate limits: 120/min (API key) vs 600/min (OAuth).

api_surface.breadth_notes: Covers audiences, members, campaigns, reports, automations, templates, e-commerce, landing pages, file manager, surveys, signup forms, and verified domains.

evidence.quote: You can authenticate requests using either your API key or an OAuth access token, depending on your use case.

The most complete Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Mailchimp Marketing API: 227 tools to query and manage your Mailchimp account.

api_surface.breadth_notes: Covers profiles, lists, segments, campaigns, flows, forms, events, metrics, images, templates, tags, subscriptions, push tokens, catalogs, coupons, and reporting.

buildability_signal.notes: Official MCP server with broad coverage. OAuth required for MCP. Private API keys for REST. Public keys for client-side only.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).

research_notes: Official MCP server with broad coverage. OAuth required for MCP and App Marketplace. Private API keys for server-side REST. Public keys for client-side only.

mcp_access.mcp_access_notes: MCP server available at https://mcp.amplitude.com/mcp (US) and https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp (EU). Add as custom connector in AI tool and complete OAuth authentication.

evidence.claim: API key and Secret key auth
evidence.quote: To find your Amplitude project's API key and secret key: In the Amplitude web app, select Settings in the lower-left navigation.
